purpose: Regime-specific evidence and project decisions; not one pooled parameter set

sources.finding: Amorphous hydrogenated material, competing Si-N/Si-Si/Si-H cleavage and salt formation.
sources.project_inference: Keep chemistry tied to hydrogenated amorphous motifs; include retention before claiming self-limitation.
sources.access_scope: Publisher abstract/introduction and public author poster

sources.regime: Fluorinated nitride/oxide under NF3/N2/O2/H2 remote plasma
sources.finding: HF coadsorption, water assistance and HF vibrational excitation change the reaction network.
sources.project_inference: Treat coadsorbate occupancy and flux explicitly; keep these rates in a separate regime.

sources.finding: Intact CH3F chemisorption alone does not account for a complete ALE mechanism.
sources.project_inference: Compare reactive fragments and ion-created sites; do not infer sticking from a neutral approach minimum.

sources.finding: Coverage and orientation affect bond-breaking; a reactive potential can miss the ordering.
sources.project_inference: Benchmark reaction energies and forces at matched termination, not only the ideal facet.

sources.finding: Agreement with ion-beam experiments depends on matching ion fluence.
sources.project_inference: Keep ion-driven removal separate; validate exposure and fluence as well as energy.

sources.finding: MD and a reduced model link the narrow ALE window to chemical versus physical sputtering.
sources.project_inference: An energy-window claim needs both removal and damage channels, not thermal Arrhenius chemistry alone.

sources.regime: NF3/H2 remote plasma plus methanol and heating
sources.finding: Changing radicals and retained products permits oxide-selective cyclic removal.
sources.project_inference: Selectivity is recipe-dependent; do not extrapolate a universal nitride/oxide ranking.

sources.finding: DFT/TST elementary rates are connected to spatial correlations and measured observables.
sources.project_inference: The current independent-motif grid does not supply those correlations; add interactions only with data.

sources.finding: Rate-control analysis examines how elementary processes affect kinetic outputs.
sources.project_inference: Use transient endpoint sensitivity for this pulsed model; do not relabel it a steady-state degree of rate control.

sources.finding: Foundation choice, consistent references and task-level validation matter for fine tuning.
sources.project_inference: Use DFT forces and barrier profiles; split held-out data by reaction/surface rather than neighboring path frames.
